info.title: Eki backend HTTP API
info.description: HTTP contract for the 39 existing handlers and six compatible v2 aliases from PR #197. Firebase SDK listeners are documented separately in docs/api/HTTP_CONTRACT.md; they are not HTTP operations. Legacy URLs remain supported; no retirement date is scheduled. REST naming alone promises no performance improvement.
